screen: County-held-out one-term D3 housing-unit intensity residual correction; descriptive-only

method.feature: Raw log ratio ln(ACS housing_units / Overture building count) from provided D3 inputs, with the emitted D3 mask; D3's globally RUCA-standardized emitted values are read only to verify support, not used for fitting.
method.housing_unit_role: Covariate only. ACS housing units are never used as an official building-gap denominator, floor, replacement reference, or target proxy.
method.outcome: Pinned frozen cross-fitted S1 Queen/Rook disagreement residual; no labels and no refit.
method.validation: Within each official region, leave one supported county out; fit intercept and one feature coefficient on all other supported counties in that region. Each supported tract is predicted once.
method.scaling: For each county fold, standardize the single raw log-ratio term with mean and population SD computed from training counties only; zero SD uses scale 1.
method.baseline: Unmodified frozen S1 residual (zero correction); compare paired OOF corrected SSE with sum of squared frozen residuals on identical support.
method.metric: Pooled county-held-out incremental ΔR²=(baseline SSE-corrected OOF SSE)/baseline SSE; region/stratum analogues use the same zero-correction baseline.
method.uncertainty: Paired county-block bootstrap of OOF baseline/model SSEs, counties sampled with replacement within each region.
method.strata: Report frozen-residual summaries and held-out correction ΔR² for pct_urban<0.5 rural, >=0.5 urban, and within-region provided SVI quartiles; minimum n=100 per pooled stratum for degradation gate.
method.interpretation_limit: Provided-feature residual association only; not target accuracy, causality, or estimator promotion.

county_block_bootstrap.resampling: paired leave-one-county-out SSEs; resample counties with replacement within each official region

config.feature: ln(provided ACS housing_units / provided Overture overture_buildings)
config.support: ACS_HU>0, Overture buildings>0, valid provided RUCA in [1,10]; exact emitted D3 mask, 9,299 tracts
config.validation: leave one five-digit county GEOID out within each official region
config.correction: intercept + one term, fit in training counties only; term standardized by training-fold mean and population SD
config.baseline: no correction to frozen S1 residual; baseline SSE=sum(y^2) on the exact paired OOF support

strata.svi_quartiles: within-region empirical quartiles of provided svi_minority

interpretation: The county-held-out screen failed one or more predeclared gates; retain descriptive-only and do not integrate.
